_comment: Optional per-project config. Goes to data/webapp/config.json at runtime. Equivalent fields can be set on the ProjectDeclaration in deepaudit.config.ts (priorityPaths, promptAppend); if both are present, this file wins.
promptAppend: Tenant scoping is the most load-bearing convention in this codebase. Every DB query on a tenant-scoped table must filter by req.session.user.companyId; flag any that don't.
